Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Craft_LootPeripheral: Chance to find the installable Craft add-on peripheral (GS 3D Printer), fully assembled. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Craft_LootMagazineWe: Chance to find the Craft add-on magazine. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Craft_LootDiskProgra: Loot weight: Craft install disk magazine
Chance to find the magazine that teaches how to program the Craft install disk. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Craft_LootComponentW: Chance to find any of the 3 loose 3D Printer parts (Frame, Extruder Head, Control Board). 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Craft_DebugMode_tool: Enables extra console logging for the Craft add-on only. No gameplay effect.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Craft_LootInstallDis: Multiplier for how often the already-programmed Craft install disk spawns as loot in the world (separate from its blank/programmable counterpart). 1.0 = normal, 0 = never spawns (craft-only).
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Craft_Recipe_Printer: If ON, this item can be crafted from its recipe. If OFF, the recipe does not exist and Printer Frame can only be found in the world as loot.
If ON, the recipe for Printer Frame must be learned from its own magazine/manual before it can be crafted. If OFF, it is known from the start. Has no effect if the recipe above is disabled.
